events.line: Josh Allen just put up 40.8 points and made Ilir look like a fucking genius for once in his miserable fantasy life—too bad this is the exception that proves the rule, because next week he'll bench him for some waiver wire dart throw and we'll all get to watch this shit show unfold again.

Rilind actually benched his brain this week and started St. Brown anyway—the man's out here breaking his own projection in half like a Vegas odds maker's confidence, and somehow that's still not enough to save this dumpster fire of a season.

Ilir finally remembered tight ends are actual roster spots and not just bye-week placeholders, and Kincaid decided to go absolutely nuclear for once—guess even a broken clock is right twice a day, and somehow you managed to be holding it at the exact moment it mattered.

Rinor really said "DJ Moore is gonna pop off this week" and then watched him accumulate negative points like he was collecting a damn debt—maybe next time trust your gut instead of whatever fever dream told you to start him.
Rob, Jameson Williams put up 4.3 points and you started him anyway—that's not faith in your roster, that's just negligence with a side of wishful thinking.

LaPorta absolutely shit the bed on your bench last week, so of course he decides to actually show up when you finally plug him in—14 points is basically a miracle from that guy and you still only *barely* beat his projection like you deserve a medal for it.
